title: SseFrame::id: tri-state conflation comment buried in struct doc, not in type
description: sse.rs SseFrame: The doc comment explains that bare 'id:' (reset) and missing 'id:' (unchanged) both produce id: None. This is a semantically important difference for reconnect logic. The explanation is in the struct-level doc only — a contributor reading parse_sse_block will see 'id = if v.is_empty() { None } ...' and wonder why a non-empty id check is being used here rather than Option::None vs Some(""). The comment should be co-located with the code that makes the decision (the id: None assignment in parse_sse_block), not only at the struct level. The current placement means a contributor refactoring parse_sse_block could break the semantics without seeing the contract.
